annotations.title: Court Practice on a Statute Article

description:
Court practice on one statute article: which cases cite it, by court and year,
ranked highest authority first.

Spellings of one code answer alike ('ККУ', 'КК України') and mean the code in
force; `repealed_excluded` lists repealed namesakes' nregs.

`index_coverage.status` says what `total_cases` means (a real zero, or
unresolved citations); under `index_unavailable` it is null, not a count.

abbreviation.description: Code abbreviation (ККУ), or act nreg or title.

limit.description: Max rows to return (0-200); 0 returns the count alone.
